newsitem.title: POLAND: NOVITA SELLS STAKE IN SUBSIDIARY.
newsitem.headline: NOVITA SELLS STAKE IN SUBSIDIARY.

text.p: Polish carpet maket Novita SA has sold a 10.5-percent stake in its subsidiary, retail trader Novita Market SA, to Armstrong Enterprises Inc. for 3.2 million zlotys, the firm's chief accountant said on Thursday.

Jan Bogusz said Novita planned to let Armstrong Enterprsies, a subsidiary of the U.S.-based Armstrong World Industries, buy up to 30 percent of Novita Market, a chain of 50 shops and warehouses, by taking up the firm's new issue.
"We plan that up to 30 percent (of shares of Novita Market) can go to Armstrong," he told Reuters. He added Novita did not want to lose control over Novita Market.
